verdict.rationale: LM Studio is distributed as a downloadable desktop app/installer (per lmstudio.ai/download and docs) and a headless 'llmster' binary/daemon, with community users confirming simple installs ('simple install, just search... and it downloads and just works') rather than building from source. missing for 10: explicit mention of package manager support (e.g., brew/apt/winget) or checksums/signing, and independent third-party verification of the binary installer process beyond community anecdotes.
